'''Gedron Hix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as one of Nem'ro's agents on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he asked a passerby to lead an assault on one of [[Voontara Fa'athra]]'s factories.
